description: Roadmap A14 / TD-109: one scripted Play of valley-project's scenario. Both engines' ScenarioRuntime must produce exactly this rule log and end state (desktop: ScenarioTraceTest; web: scenarioRuntime.test.ts). Frames of 0.25 s and 0.5 s are exact in binary floating point, so the two clocks agree and no logged time is a rounding tie.

steps.note: a non-player entity in the door area does not count
after the end nothing more runs

log: Rule 'Welcome' at 2.0 s: message "Find the house in the valley."
Rule 'Arrived' at 3.5 s: objective complete, message "You reached the house!", end: Victory
